penalties.details: The Company had multiple instances of non-seeding of Universal Account Numbers (UANs) with Aadhaar, resulting in non-compliance with the applicable Aadhaar seeding requirements. Consequently, challans pertaining to these instances were generated and paid from April 2026 to May 2026, including the applicable amounts under Section 7Q and Section 14B of the Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952.
penalties.impact: The matter does not have any material impact on the financials, operations or other activities of the Company.

timeline.summary: Eureka Forbes Limited scheduled an earnings conference call for Q4 FY2026 & FY2026 results on May 20, 2026, at 2:00 PM IST with **Mr. Pratik Pota (MD & CEO)** and **Mr. Gaurav Khandelwal (CFO)**.
Lunolux Limited, acting with Christodoulos Patsalides, declared no new share encumbrances in Eureka Forbes Limited for FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Eureka Forbes reported Q4 FY26 standalone revenue of ₹683.83 Cr and PAT of ₹51.09 Cr, weighed down by a ₹40.44 Cr labour code provision.
Eureka Forbes reported Q4 FY26 standalone revenue of ₹683.8 Cr, up 11.6% YoY, with an adjusted EBITDA margin of 13.2%.
Shilpa Jain uploaded the audio recording of the May 20, 2026, analysts/investor conference call on Eureka Forbes Limited’s website.
Eureka Forbes reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹684 Cr, up 11.6% YoY, with an adjusted EBITDA margin of 13.2%.
Eureka Forbes Limited will attend Axis Capital's Rising Stars Conference on June 02, 2026, in Mumbai (Physical – Group) as per Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations, signed by Shilpa Jain.
Eureka Forbes Limited scheduled an earnings conference call for Q2 and H1 FY27 results on November 03, 2026, at 02:00 PM IST, led by **Pratik Pota (MD & CEO)** and **Gaurav Khandelwal (CFO)**.
